summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Fase 2C.2 - Aprobaciones y Exoneración de Responsabilidad Económica. All 20 backend tests passed (100%). Fixed a bug in actualizar_calculo method. Frontend UI verified working correctly with modal interactions.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug in ResponsabilidadRepository.actualizar_calculo() - was passing UUID 'id' to update() which expects MongoDB ObjectId
Permission validation by role/amount working: SUPERVISOR ≤$500, GERENTE_OPS ≤$2000, DIRECCION unlimited
Comment validation working: minimum 10 chars, trivial comments rejected
Historial correctly records all transitions with user, role, comment, and timestamp
APROBADO does NOT close workflow (stays EN_REVISION_FINANCIERA)
RECHAZADO/EXONERADO close workflow to CERRADO when no other active calculations
seed_data_creation: Used existing workflows with forzar_recalculo to reset states for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fase 2C.2 Aprobaciones fully tested. Key findings: 1) All 6 state transitions work: CALCULADO→PROPUESTO, PROPUESTO→APROBADO/RECHAZADO/EXONERADO/EN_DISPUTA, EN_DISPUTA→PROPUESTO/EXONERADO/RECHAZADO. 2) Permission thresholds: SUPERVISOR ≤$500, GERENTE_OPS ≤$2000, DIRECCION unlimited. 3) EXONERAR always requires GERENTE_OPS or higher. 4) Comments must be ≥10 chars and non-trivial. 5) GET /api/v2/responsabilidad/pendientes-aprobacion and /en-disputa work. 6) GET /api/v2/responsabilidad/{id}/historial returns full transition history. 7) Frontend ResponsabilidadPendientesPanel and ResponsabilidadAccionesModal working correctly.

POST /api/v2/responsabilidad/{id}/propon.details: CALCULADO → PROPUESTO transition works with proper permission validation

POST /api/v2/responsabilidad/{id}/aproba.details: PROPUESTO → APROBADO transition works, workflow stays EN_REVISION_FINANCIERA

POST /api/v2/responsabilidad/{id}/rechaz.details: PROPUESTO → RECHAZADO transition works, workflow closes to CERRADO

POST /api/v2/responsabilidad/{id}/disput.details: PROPUESTO → EN_DISPUTA works, AFECTADO can initiate

Comment validation ≥10 chars.details: Short and trivial comments rejected with 422

GET /api/v2/responsabilidad/{id}/histori.details: Returns complete transition history with all fields

Frontend ResponsabilidadPendientesPanel.details: Panel displays pendientes and en-disputa tabs, rows expand with action buttons

Frontend ResponsabilidadAccionesModal.details: Modal opens with correct fields: usuario_id, rol, comentario

bug_fixed.issue: Was passing UUID 'id' field to update() method which expects MongoDB ObjectId string
bug_fixed.fix: Changed to use find_one_and_update with workflow_id filter instead of update() with id
